provenance: Integration review of the framed Given/Shared/Functions chapters and upstream link-audit changes. Read the changed raw units and exact selected declarations/tests, compared the previously reviewed unchanged material and unit-specific reasoning, and reviewed links, target passages and exceptional forward references against retained chapter context. Corrected stale local-completion descriptions and misplaced/missing definition links. No subagents or independent reviewers were used. Conservative full-source snapshots are freshness inputs, not a claim to have audited every proof tactic.
rationale: Comparison for unit:meta.syntax.heap.rendering against rust:mdbook-dada/src/graph.rs:render, rust:mdbook-dada/src/lib.rs:render, rust:mdbook-dada/src/lib.rs:selector_header, test:mdbook-dada/tests/book.rs:heap_fences_render_and_preserve_source, test:mdbook-dada/src/graph.rs:tests::facts_render_unicode_fields_and_reference_kinds, test:mdbook-dada/src/graph.rs:lease_tests::leases_join_edges_and_shleases_target_objects, test:mdbook-dada/src/graph.rs:cycle_tests::cycles_self_loops_and_disconnected_cycles_render_deterministically. render emits one labeled edge per occupied slot, derives positions deterministically from explicit ownership reachability, routes leases to explicit support junctions and preserves escaped source in desc/Facts. Tests count edge kinds and junctions, compare deterministic cyclic renderings and retain the original facts. No implicit support edges or language ownership validity are inferred. Notation and judgment context was checked in unit:meta.math.source_view, unit:meta.syntax.heap.validation.
limitations: Author self-review, not an independent review. Implementation and test inspection does not establish universal correctness, browser appearance, CDN availability, or authenticated execution. Mechanical results are retained separately.
